task.title: TG /vibecode: dashboard control panel van sai so thiet bi (so BAN GHI != so MAY)
task.detail: Nguyen van chu du an (bus #591, owner -> win, 2026-09-29T16:08:47Z): 'dashboard tren control panel van sai so thiet bi'. Truoc do (#584) da sua dong dem UDID o tab iOS; con the 'Devices' tren Dashboard = totals.devices = realDevices.length = so BAN GHI dang ky trong data/devices.json (10), khong phai so MAY that. Nguyen nhan goc: app Android sinh cap khoa + ten may MOI moi lan cai lai (DeviceIdentity luu trong SecureStore, xoa du lieu/go app la mat) nen moi lan cai lai sinh mot ban ghi moi; tai khoan minhnb2@me.com dang 6 ban ghi (1 macos + 5 android) trong khi chi co 1 may Mac + 1 dien thoai Android. Pham vi: (1) control-plane node-2: them ma may on dinh (machine_id) vao ban ghi thiet bi + dem 'so may that'; (2) app Android (kenh Windows phat hanh): gui machine_id on dinh (Settings.Secure.ANDROID_ID) trong register/claim.
task.verify: node ops/_scratch/verify-device-machines.mjs --live (tren node-2) in ra so MAY that; the Devices tren Dashboard hien dung bang so do; so ban ghi cu van hien ro
